_help.about: The player's movement table (PlanetPlayer reads it at start; restart the game after editing). Speeds in m/s, rates in m/s², times in seconds, distances in metres. The feel is Melee's spacies: heavy, snappy, committed jumps.
_help.speed: Top speeds on the ground: walk, sprint (double-tap forward and hold), sneak (hold Shift), aim (while the bow is drawn or the spear raised, on the ground only), swim. swim_accel: how quickly you get up to swimming speed. double_tap_s: the most time between the two taps of forward that start a sprint.
_help.ground: accel: how fast you reach speed. friction: how fast you stop (lower = longer slide). turnaround_keep: pushing the other way at speed keeps this much of your old speed for a brief skid, then you go. turnaround_min_mps: below this there's no skid.
_help.traction: Multiplies ground accel and friction by what's underfoot: lower = slidier (a longer slide on stop). wet is shallow water and rain-soaked ground.
_help.air: gravity: the pull (twice Earth's for a heavy fall). jump_mps: take-off speed (a short hop). sprint_jump: the take-off speed is multiplied by this at a sprint (a longer jump). fast_fall_mps: press crouch in the air after the apex to drop at once at this speed. max_fall_mps: terminal speed. air_accel: how quickly you steer in the air. air_steer_mps: how far your air speed can move from your take-off speed (so a jump commits you).
_help.landing: squat_s: the frames of landing squat (no jump, no steering). heavy_squat_s: after a fall higher than heavy_fall_m (about a body length). dip_m: how far the view dips in the squat. min_drop_m: running off a bump lower than this (without jumping) is no landing at all.
_help.fall_damage: A drop higher than safe_m (metres, from the top of the fall) hurts: per_m hit points for each metre over. Measured by height, so a fast-fall out of a hop never hurts.
_help.wall_jump: kick_s: how long the kick animation lasts. Right click in the air within window_s of touching a wall, cliff, trunk or ruin face: kicks you off it back the way you came, angled up. speed_mps and angle_deg: the kick. chain_decay: each further wall jump before you land keeps this fraction of the last one's upward speed. min_wall_steepness: how steep a surface counts as a wall (0 = vertical only, 0.5 = up to 60° from vertical). noise_m: how far the scuff is heard.
_help.climb: On a tree's branches (the handholds): graph_trunk_mps is the body's speed during a reach up or round a trunk, graph_limb_mps along a limb; trunk_beat_s / limb_beat_s the pause after each reach. simple_mps: climbing a trunk that has no handholds. reach_m: how far ahead a trunk can be for E to start climbing. grab_s: how long a hand takes to reach for something (a stuck spear) while climbing.
_help.burden: Carrying more than free_items things (the inventory's carry slots), each thing more makes you slow_per_item slower (never below min_speed of your normal speed), climb climb_slow_per_item slower, noise_per_item louder, and lean lean_per_item radians further forward. Felt, never shown as a number.
_help.wet_ground: soaked_rain_mm_h: rain this heavy (mm per hour) soaks the ground fully (traction falls to 'wet'); lighter rain soaks it partly. dry_s: after the rain stops, how long soaked ground takes to dry.
_help.unstick: Stuck is touching something and going nowhere: wedged between two walls (a trunk and a shrub's stem), held off the ground (under a root, in a fork), or caught on a crease of the ground. After stall_s moving slower than stall_mps, you're nudged nudge_m out along the free direction nearest to where you push. ground_jam_s: caught on the ground alone, you're freed after only this long (a hitch you barely feel).
